_comment: Typing vectors of a layout's own repeat and magic keys in the layout source emulation (docs/design/magic-and-repeat-keys.md). Each case replays steps on a fresh session of context_emulation.json, the table the source compiler writes for context_source.toml per platform, as emulation_vectors.json does; a press carries « before », the text typed so far that the driver passes (its last typed text). The repeat key is on the ISO key left of Z, the skip-repeat key on its Shift level, the magic key (« after e types d », « after d types e », « after ce types s ») on the key right of L; the letters are native. The web emulation (source_emulation.js), the Lua engine of macOS and Linux (layouts/engine/composer/source_emulation.lua) and the AutoHotkey engine of Windows (modules/keymap/keylayout/source_emulation.ahk) replay them.

cases.name: the repeat key types the last character typed
the repeat key types nothing before any text, and is still taken
the repeat key repeats a character outside the basic plane whole
Shift and the repeat key type the character before the last one
the magic key types d after e, e after d, nothing after another character
the magic key takes the rule with the longest context
a native letter is left to the layout
